page_title: GET 1-0 CAD | Getafe v Cadiz CF 06/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+1' A snap shot by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Conan Ledesma produces a good save to thwart him.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' It will be a substitution. Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) is ready to enter the pitch as Borja Mayoral walks off.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) was quite harsh and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Here is a change. Mason Greenwood is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
85' Luis Milla (Getafe) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

85' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Conan Ledesma anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
84' Substitution. Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) in, Rominigue Kouame out.
82' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:6.
79' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
78' The attendance for today's match is 9853.
76' 1 - 0 GOAL! The corner comes over and Mason Greenwood wins a simple header before Borja Mayoral (Getafe) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
76' Luis Milla (Getafe) will take the corner.
75' Sergio prepares a substitution. Roger Marti is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
75' The substitution has been made. Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) has replaced Chris Ramos.
73' Flag up against Chris Ramos (Cadiz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
73' Cadiz CF hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
68' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
66' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
66' The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
63' Luis Milla (Getafe) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
62' It's time for a substitution. Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) comes on in place of Ruben Alcaraz.
60' Luis Milla (Getafe) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
59' Damian Suarez (Getafe) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
57' Although Carles Alena (Getafe) is just on the bench, Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
55' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
52' The linesman signals that Chris Ramos (Cadiz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
50' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
49' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
48' Cadiz CF are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jaime Mata comes off for Luis Milla (Getafe).
46' Sergio makes a half-time substitution. Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) comes on in place of Robert Navarro.
46' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+5' Jaime Mata (Getafe) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
45+4' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

45+1' Roger Marti (Cadiz) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
45+1' Cadiz CF force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
44' Djene (Getafe) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
44' It‘s just a yellow card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea got that spot on and Djene (Getafe) can continue. VAR seen to good effect there!
44' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Cadiz CF! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea and both teams have no complaints.
43' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Cadiz CF! Let's see what he decides.
41' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

40' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but David Soria shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
36' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
35' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
34' Getafe players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
31' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle after Mason Greenwood (Getafe) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
29' Damian Suarez (Getafe) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
27' The game is interrupted as Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) is flagged offside.
24' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
23' Omar Alderete (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
19' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria easily deals with the threat.
18' Jaime Mata (Getafe) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
17' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
16' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz).
14' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
13' Djene (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
10' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Robert Navarro (Cadiz) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
10' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
9' Roger Marti (Cadiz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
7' A corner kick by Getafe is thwarted by the well prepared Conan Ledesma (Cadiz).

7' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
6' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
4' Rough tackle by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Djene (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
